company.name: Duolingo
company.why_target: Design is company's second-largest division, Ryan Sims first CDO, 105-person design org growing to 130
company.notes: Ryan Sims is first-ever CDO (promoted April 2024). Mig Reyes is VP of Product Experience. Design is second-largest dept behind engineering. Actively hiring design directors. Pittsburgh + NYC remote-friendly.

brief.executive_summary: Design is company's second-largest division, Ryan Sims first CDO, 105-person design org growing to 130
brief.design_ops_need: Design team at Duolingo needs systematic AI-augmented ops infrastructure.
pain_points: Scaling design output without proportional headcount growth
Inconsistent AI tool adoption across design team
opportunity_angles: A new CDO scaling a 130-person team is exactly the moment where ops infrastructure pays off most. The question is whether you build it before or after the scale creates problems.
personalization_hooks: Ryan Sims just became Duolingo's first-ever Chief Design Officer, growing design into the company's second-largest division
hiring design directors as the design team scales from 105 to 130+ people
brief.outreach_strategy: Direct LinkedIn outreach to CDO Ryan Sims
